groups.title: 1. Fabric, global settings and switch inventory
groups.intro: Pre-checks and fabric creation: collection roles that load defaults, validate the data model and test the controller, then the fabric type, global settings, switch inventory, vPC and ToR pairing, and NX-OS baseline modules.

groups.title: 2. Underlay
groups.intro: Underlay addressing, IGP, BGP, BFD and multicast, fabric links and edge connections, then the matching NX-OS routing modules.

groups.title: 3. Overlay (NVE, EVPN, VNIs)
groups.intro: VTEP and NVE interface, EVPN control plane, BGP L2VPN EVPN address family, VNI mapping and IGMP snooping for BUM traffic.

groups.title: 4. VRFs
groups.intro: Tenant VRFs and VRF attach groups, VRF-Lite extensions, then the controller and NX-OS VRF modules.

groups.title: 5. Networks
groups.intro: Overlay networks (L2 and L3 VNIs) and network attach groups, then controller networks and NX-OS VLAN-to-VNI mapping.

groups.title: 6. Interfaces and access
groups.intro: Breakouts, access and trunk ports, port-channels, routed and sub-interfaces, loopbacks and dot1q tunnels, then vPC pairs and NX-OS interface modules.

groups.title: 7. Policies and route control
groups.intro: Route-control objects (prefix lists, community lists, AS-path lists, MAC lists, object groups, ACLs, time ranges, route-maps) and freeform policies, then the controller policy and template modules and NX-OS policy modules.

groups.title: 8. Deploy, Day 2 and operations
groups.intro: Collection roles that create, deploy and remove controller state, then image management, maintenance mode, REST and NX-OS operational modules.

groups.title: 9. Multi-site, services and other
groups.intro: Multi-Site Domain (MSD) data model and fabric groups, L4-L7 service nodes and policies, and controller logging.
